title: Aether-Vault policy pack (GET /api/policy-packs/{id}, v1.3.1)
description: python/av_server/server.py::_policy_pack_to_dict(). One entry in the append-only, hash-chained policy publication log — chain_hash = sha256(f"{prev_id or ''}:{object_id}"). See docs/contracts.md.

object_id.description: CAS object id of the policy document (signed, if published with --sign).

prev_id.description: Previous pack in this project's chain; null for the first.
